resources.string: English toxicity detection runs on this device. Clipboard history is not collected. Your personal dictionary, flagged words, false-positive reports and activity counts are saved in encrypted local storage. App backup and transfer are excluded.\n\nNothing is submitted automatically. If you confirm Upload Contribution, the reviewed words and sentences, an authenticated installation ID and submission time are sent to Firebase for model research. If you confirm Upload Research Report, activity counts and usage time, together with an authenticated installation ID and submission time, are sent to Firebase; no message text is included. Administrators can retain submissions; deleting local data does not delete server records.

English analysis runs locally. Clipboard history is not collected. Dictionary entries, feedback and activity counts are encrypted on this device and excluded from backup and transfer. Feedback text is uploaded only after review and confirmation; research metrics require a separate confirmation. Uploads include an authenticated installation ID and timestamp. Research administrators can retain submissions. Clearing local records does not remove server records.
You can only contribute once every minute. Please try again in %1$d seconds.
Reduce toxicity in your digital life with real-time AI-powered filtering and suggestions.

Typing analysis runs locally on your device. Messages are not sent during ordinary typing. Only information you explicitly choose to upload, such as selected feedback or a research report, leaves your phone.
